target_repo.description: Absolute target repository path, or '.' for the active project (wherever .council/ was bootstrapped).

security.description: Model for the Security agent. Optional; defaults to 'sonnet' when omitted.

verifier.description: Model for the Verifier (QA) agent. Optional; defaults to 'sonnet' when omitted.

dynamic_agents.description: Policy for temporary per-cycle specialist agents. Optional; defaults to {enabled: false, max_parallel: 4, timeout_minutes: 10} when omitted -- opt in per goal once a run actually needs a specialist domain.

verifier.description: Policy for the Verifier (QA) role, which authors regression coverage for the cycle's diff. Optional; defaults to {enabled: true, max_test_files: 2} when omitted. Set enabled:false for docs-only or otherwise non-code goals so a cycle does not spend a seat on it.

loop.description: Settings for the unattended loop runner (loop mode). Optional; every key has a default injected when omitted. Loop mode also requires target_repo '.', dry_run false, auto_commit true, and a base_branch other than main/master (see council_state.py loop-check).

max_attempts.description: Attempts per task before it is marked failed.

backoff.description: Retry delay for rate-limit/API errors: base_seconds x 2^n, capped at max_seconds, +/- jitter fraction.

base_branch.description: Branch task branches are cut from and merged into. Set by 'loop init'; main/master are refused.

tasks_file.description: Task list path, relative to the project.

logs_dir.description: Log directory, relative to the project.

permission_mode.description: Passed to each loop session as --permission-mode. bypassPermissions is refused.

allowed_tools.description: Extra --allowedTools entries for loop sessions (empty = no flag).

protected_paths.description: Globs for existing test files/config; modifying or deleting one blocks the task until approved.

command.description: For backend 'command': argv template; '{name}' is replaced by the secret name, '{python}' by the running Python interpreter, and the value is read from stdout (never passed via argv).

telegram_token_secret.description: Secret NAME (not value) of the Telegram bot token.

telegram_chat_secret.description: Secret NAME (not value) of the owner's Telegram chat id.

brain_events.description: Best-effort Brain event emission after a driver run. Optional; defaults to {enabled: false, url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8765'} when omitted -- this is a personal-infra integration, opt in only if you actually run a Brain server.

dry_run.description: When true, the council plans/reviews but must not modify, stage, commit, push, or open PRs.

open_pr.description: When true, accepted auto-commit cycles print a PR-ready handoff summary. Hosted PR creation requires an external wrapper or user action.

transcripts.description: When true, each cycle writes a readable transcript under .council/state/transcripts/.

test_commands.description: Optional explicit verification commands for the target repo. Empty means auto-discover.

modelName.description: Claude Code model alias or explicit model slug.
